nodes.label: Reporters — end-of-run --report json/junit/html/http and --summary-export; streaming report.reporters std/report/serve@v1, prometheus-rw@v1, otel@v1

Streaming reporter delivery guarantees: bounded queue, batched sends, retry with backoff, final flush; a slow backend can never block VUs or fail the run; during_run on final-only reporter is a lint/run error
